topIssues.title: SDM: tests hardening
topIssues.author: nonsense
topIssues.body:
- [ ] No ETH supply conservation test. Nothing asserts senderCredit == Σ debits or audits total balance before/after a refund block. This is the single most valuable test to add — an acceptance test summing all touched balances across a 100%-refund block would directly encode the "no infinite mint" property.
- [ ] PostExecSettlementUnderflow is never triggered in tests. The error path exists but no test crafts a block where a fee recipient can't absorb the debit.
- [ ] No test for a 0x7D tx positioned mid-block (the not-last rejection at post_exec.rs:180 is untested), and no explicit out-of-order-index payload test.

topIssues.title: feat(op-reth): reuse upstream slot-preimage seeding helper, remove duplication from #21108
topIssues.author: nonsense
topIssues.body:
## Background

reth has merged upstream support that exposes slot-preimage DB seeding for snapshot importers (`init-state` / `init_from_state_dump`). This is the durable fix anticipated in #21108 ("a seeding helper in `reth-db-common` so importers can't bypass it").

## Follow-up

When we originally landed #21108 (`feat(op-reth): seed slot-preimage DB during state-dump import`), we replicated reth's private `SlotPreimages::open` / `insert_preimages` logic on the op-reth side because no public API existed. The commit message explicitly flagged this as temporary:

> The MDBX env open/insert is replicated from reth's private `SlotPreimages::open`/`insert_preimages` at rev 81c0261 and must stay byte-compatible; documented in-code. The durable fix belongs upstream (a seeding helper in `reth-db-common` so importers can't bypass it).

Now that the upstream seeding helper is merged, we should:

- Remove the duplicated MDBX env open/insert logic in `rust/op-reth/crates/cli/src/commands/slot_preimages_seed.rs`.
- Reuse the upstream `reth-db-common` seeding API from `init_from_state_dump`.
- Drop any now-unnecessary dependencies / replicated constants kept only for byte-compatibility.

## Affected code

- `rust/op-reth/crates/cli/src/commands/slot_preimages_seed.rs`
- `rust/op-reth/crates/cli/src/commands/init_state.rs`
- `rust/op-reth/crates/cli/Cargo.toml`

## References

- Original PR: #21108

topIssues.title: flaky test: Go fuzz jobs `context deadline exceeded` (cannon-fuzz, fuzz-golang-op-chain-ops)
topIssues.author: wwared
topIssues.body:
Go `-fuzztime` fuzz jobs intermittently fail with `context deadline exceeded` at the fuzztime boundary — a shutdown-race under CPU contention, never a real crash input.

**Mechanism:** duration-based `-fuzztime` races a wall-clock deadline. Under CPU starvation (loaded merge-queue fleet + `parallel` self-oversubscription) a worker can't finish/ack its in-flight fuzz call before the deadline → the target FAILs. Proof: in build 5244583, `FuzzVersionedNonce` logged `execs: 16229 (0/sec)` for 8s straight (workers fully starved) while the clock kept running.

**Affected jobs:** `cannon-fuzz` and `fuzz-golang-op-chain-ops` (same bug, different recipes).

**Occurrences (all 2026-06-22, both jobs ~0 failures in prior 745 runs/90d):**

| Job | Test | fuzztime | When |
|-----|------|----------|------|
| cannon-fuzz | `FuzzStateSyscallExitGroup` | 20s | 15:29 (build 5242391) |
| cannon-fuzz | `FuzzStateHintRead` | 20s | 22:05 ([5244310](https://app.circleci.com/pipelines/github/ethereum-optimism/optimism/128703/workflows/347fb5aa-eaf9-4450-8277-3c494a31b72c/jobs/5244310)) |
| fuzz-golang-op-chain-ops | `FuzzEncodeDecodeWithdrawal` | 10s | 22:42 (build 5244583, merge queue) |

**Possible direction:** count-based `-fuzztime <N>x` has no wall-clock deadline, so starvation only slows it rather than failing. Both recipes share the pattern.

topPRs.title: devstack: run op-con-node as an L2 CL verifier (opql integration)
topPRs.author: teddyknox
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Wires **op-con-node** (the [opql](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/opql) consensus-only OP node) into `op-devstack` as an external-subprocess L2 CL kind, selectable via `DEVSTACK_L2CL_KIND=op-con-node`. This lets the devstack acceptance suite run op-con-node as a verifier CL in place of op-node/kona.

op-con-node is **verifier-only** — no sequencing, no P2P gossip. It derives the safe chain from L1 and drives its own EL (op-reth) over the Engine API; the unsafe head is followed from the sequencer's L2 EL.

## Changes

- **`op-devstack/sysgo/l2_cl_opcon.go`** — `OpConNode` launcher: spawns `op-con-node run`, polls the RPC for readiness, fronts it. Binary resolved via rustbin overrides (`RUST_BINARY_PATH_OP_CON_NODE` / `RUST_SRC_DIR_OP_CON_NODE`) since op-con-node lives in the sibling opql repo.
- **`op-devstack/sysgo/mixed_runtime.go`** — `MixedL2CLOpCon` kind + `SkipOnOpConNode`.
- **`op-devstack/sysgo/singlechain_build.go`** — dispatch verifier slots to op-con-node, keep the sequencer on op-node.
- **`op-devstack/sysgo/singlechain_variants.go`** / **`op-devstack/presets/singlechain_multinode.go`** — no-fault-proofs multinode runtime + preset (avoids requiring cannon), with the verifier's follow source wired to the sequencer L2 EL.
- **`op-acceptance-tests/tests/opcon/verifier_test.go`** — `TestOpConVerifierDerivesSafeHead`.

## Status

The acceptance test **passes** (`TestOpConVerifierDerivesSafeHead` → `ok`). The earlier safe-head-stuck blocker (op-con-node ingested from `anchor_L1_origin + 1`, so a genesis anchor never ingested L1 block 0 and `derive_batch` could not advance) was fixed on the opql side; op-con-node now derives the safe head from L1 against the devstack.

> Local opql integration. Opening per request to make the branch reviewable; not necessarily intended to merge into `develop` as-is.

## Test plan

```
DEVSTACK_L2CL_KIND=op-con-node DEVSTACK_L2EL_KIND=op-reth \
RUST_BINARY_PATH_OP_CON_NODE=<opql>/target/debug/op-con-node \
go test -run TestOpConVerifierDerivesSafeHead ./op-acceptance-tests/tests/opcon/
```

topPRs.title: feat: migration path C zkdg
topPRs.author: ashitakah
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Adds the interop migration path (Path C): `OPContractsManagerV2.setInteropDisputeGames(...)`, which re-points the shared dispute games of an already-interop set to a new respected super game in a single transaction covering all chains. Current use case is the post-migration transition from shared fault proofs to a shared super `ZKDisputeGame`. Reuses the migrator machinery; the standard `upgrade()` path can't be used since it re-inits per chain and would clobber the shared `AnchorStateRegistry` / `ETHLockbox`. Paths A and B (isolated chains) need no contract changes and go through `upgrade()`, since ZK is already in `isSuperGame`.

## Changes

### Contracts — `src/L1/opcm/OPContractsManagerMigrator.sol`

| Area | Change |
|---|---|
| `setInteropDisputeGames` | New function. Validates the chain set, re-initializes the shared `AnchorStateRegistry` with the new respected game type + anchor root, then sets the dispute game impls on the shared `DisputeGameFactory` via the existing `_getGameImpl` / `_makeGameArgs`. Enabled configs register, disabled configs clear. No new infra deployed, per-chain portals untouched. |
| Guards | Gates on `OPTIMISM_PORTAL_INTEROP` + `ZK_DISPUTE_GAME` dev features (TODO to drop the ZK gate once finalized; the function is generic across super games). Requires `startingRespectedGameType ∈ isSuperGame`. Runtime check that all portals resolve to the same shared ASR. |
| Errors | `OPContractsManagerMigrator_ZKDisputeGameNotEnabled`, `OPContractsManagerMigrator_NotSharedInteropSet`. |

### Contracts — `src/L1/opcm/OPContractsManagerV2.sol`

| Area | Change |
|---|---|
| `setInteropDisputeGames` | Thin entry point, `_onlyDelegateCall` + delegatecall to the migrator (mirrors `migrate()`). Transitional, removed once interop is native in OPCM. |
| Version | `7.1.22` → `7.1.23`. |

### Interfaces

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `interfaces/L1/opcm/IOPContractsManagerMigrator.sol` | Added `setInteropDisputeGames` + the two errors. |
| `interfaces/L1/opcm/IOPContractsManagerV2.sol` | Added `setInteropDisputeGames`. |

### Forge script — `scripts/deploy/SetInteropDisputeGames.s.sol`

| Area | Change |
|---|---|
| Script | New `Input` / `Output` / `run` mirroring `InteropMigration.s.sol`. Etches `DummyCaller` to simulate the governance delegatecall. `checkOutput` asserts on chain: all portals share the DGF, respected game type updated, and each input config applied (enabled registered, disabled cleared). |

### Op-deployer (Go)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `op-deployer/pkg/deployer/manage/set_interop_dispute_games.go` | `SetInteropDisputeGames` runner, `encodeZKGameArgs` (5-field ZK config), `SetInteropDisputeGamesCLI`. Validates all address flags with `IsHexAddress`. Default clears only `SUPER_CANNON_KONA` (9, the permissionless slot ZK replaces) and keeps `SUPER_PERMISSIONED_CANNON` (5) as the permissioned liveness backup. |
| `op-deployer/pkg/deployer/manage/flags.go` | New flags (`--system-config-proxy-addresses`, `--source-game-types`, `--zk-verifier-address`, `--zk-max-challenge-duration`, `--zk-max-prove-duration`) + `set-interop-dispute-games` command. |

### Tests

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `test/L1/opcm/OPContractsManagerV2.t.sol` | `test_setInteropDisputeGames_succeeds` (migrate to interop with SPDG + kona, swap to ZK, asserts SPDG kept, ZK registered + respected, kona cleared), `_notDelegateCalled_reverts`, `_notSharedInteropSet_reverts`. |
| `op-deployer/pkg/deployer/manage/set_interop_dispute_games_test.go` | `TestEncodeZKGameArgs` (encoder round-trip + validation), `TestSetInteropDisputeGames` (forked-Sepolia e2e: deploy with ZK impl, migrate to interop, swap, asserts the end shape on chain). |

### Snapshots

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `snapshots/semver-lock.json`, `snapshots/abi/*` | Regenerated for the OPCMv2 version bump and the new `setInteropDisputeGames` ABI. |

### Notes

- Target post-swap shape is `SUPER_PERMISSIONED_CANNON` (permissioned backup) + `ZK_DISPUTE_GAME` (permissionless, respected), mirroring today's permissioned + permissionless super shape.
- Paths A and B (single-chain `SPDG`/`SFDG` → ZK) and full game-lifecycle / finalization tests are handled in the integration tests PR.
- No on-chain validator covers the post-swap state yet (StandardValidator super-mode is gated on `SUPER_ROOT_GAMES_MIGRATION`; MigrationValidator requires the cannon super types). Tracked with the `ZKDG-NOSHAPE` TODO.
- op-challenger ZK actor needs interop super-root handling + the invalid-parent challenge fix (#21445) before the games can be defended in production.

Closes https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20759

topPRs.title: ci: suppress needrestart interactive dialog in apt-get steps
topPRs.author: circleci-app
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- The `rust-test-rollup-boost` CI job was hanging indefinitely on the "Install apt packages" step because `apt-get install clang` triggered an interactive ncurses dialog ("Daemons using outdated libraries") from the `needrestart` package.
- Fixed by adding `export NEEDRESTART_MODE=a` and using `sudo -E` (to pass the env var through sudo) in all inline `apt-get install` commands in `.circleci/continue/main.yml` that were missing this guard.
- This aligns with the existing pattern in the `apt-install` reusable command defined in the same file (which already had `NEEDRESTART_MODE=a`).

## Affected jobs
- `rust-test-vendored` (used by `rust-test-rollup-boost` and `rust-test-op-rbuilder`)
- `rust-build-vendored` (used by `rust-build-op-rbuilder` and `rust-build-rollup-boost`)
- `rust-lint-vendored` (used by `rust-lint-op-rbuilder`)

[Original failing job](https://app.circleci.com/jobs/gh/ethereum-optimism/optimism/5040216)
